$comment: Production record, 29 Aug 2026, UNMODIFIED. DIALECT A, the canonical lorastats dialect: bare field names, integer values, carrying fsk_received, rx_short_pkt and timespan. All three dialects have been ACCEPTED since 8 Sep 2026 and normalise into these same bare integer members, so this data block is also what valid/lorastats-dialect-string-values.json and valid/lorastats-dialect-prefixed.json look like once the Writer has finished with them - which is why openapi.yaml draws both its lorastats examples from these three files. A fourth spelling still dead-letters: see invalid/lorastats-dialect-unknown.json. NOTE: production sends tenant == maintenant == "mzc", which is exactly the trap: only tenant isolates, and equal values cannot reveal a filter on the wrong field. This fixture is kept byte-faithful because its job is to be a production regression guard; it is NOT an isolation test. The *-tenant-isolation-pair.json fixtures, where the two values deliberately differ, remain the only isolation guards.
